measurements_note: Times are measurements only; no budget, no cap. Source reading preceded the start stamp.

formulas.SF_b_sandwich: kd*4*tf*(d+tf)*E/(R^2*sqrt(1-nu^2))/p; at equal face mass scales as (E/rho)
formulas.SF_y_sandwich: 4*sigma*tf/R/p; at equal face mass scales as (sigma_c/rho)
formulas.kd_scaling: SF_b(kd) = SF_b(0.2)*kd/0.2 (linear in kd; required E as 1/kd)
formulas.P1_equal_mass: at fixed shell mass t follows 1/rho: SF_b follows E/rho^2, SF_y follows sigma/rho (005)
formulas.P3_equal_mass: at fixed member mass and outer radius the wall follows 1/rho: SF_b follows E/rho, SF_y follows sigma/rho (005)
formulas.wrinkling: sigma_f = pR/(4*tf); sigma_wr = 0.5*(E_f*Ec*Gc)^(1/3); require Ec*Gc >= (2*sigma_f)^3/E_f; SF_wr = (avail/req)^(1/3)
